evals.prompt: Draw the company's flywheel and tell me where to put effort next month.
evals.expected_output: A loop with numbered links and one input to push.
expectations: Draws a closed loop of four to six links
Gives each link a measured number or marks it a guess
Picks one controllable input to push, not an output like revenue

evals.prompt: Would cutting our price to $10 a month spin the flywheel?
evals.expected_output: Tests the price link with numbers and names the margin risk.
expectations: Checks whether a lower price actually brings members, with data or marked guess
Names the cost: revenue per member and margin
Says what number would prove or disprove the link
Does not assume the loop spins

evals.prompt: Make a chart of last week's closing-line value by league.
